text:
​@@Sq-1011
Produce 48 was the Avengers of survival shows. To give you the short list, it had Chaewon, Yunjin and Sakura of Le Sserafim; Wonyoung and Yujin of Ive; it had Kwon Eunbi, Choi Yena, AleXa, Jo Yuri, Kim Minju, Lee Sian, and Lee Chaeyeon; it had Jang Gyuri of fromis_9; Park Haeyoon of Cherry Bullet; Wang Yiren and Kim Shiyeon of Everglow; Takahashi Juri and Kim Sohee of Rocket Punch; Na Goeun and Park Jieun of Purple Kiss; Kim Nayoung and Han Chowon of Lightsum; Kim Doah of Fanatics, Park Jinny of Secret Number, and Yabuki Nako of AKB48.

For me the programme was a crash course in K-pop. Before Produce 48 I had never seen or heard anything about K-pop outside of Gangnam Style. Afterward, I was familiar with the members of basically every girl group that debuted for the next five years. When people talk about that programme as though it defined an era, they are not exaggerating.
